title: Database
description: Practices for schemas, queries, and migrations.

practices.title: Parameterize always
practices.statement: Use parameterized statements; string-built SQL is rejected regardless of escaping.

practices.title: Forward-safe migrations
practices.statement: Migrations must apply to existing production data; be additive first and destructive deliberately.

practices.title: Index for query patterns
practices.statement: Every frequent query pattern has a supporting index; watch for N+1 loops.

practices.title: Transaction boundaries
practices.statement: Invariants that must hold together change inside one transaction.
